Lauren / Jonas — attaching the latest roster (subprocessor_roster_20260901.xlsx) and a short note describing the edge caching partner configuration (edge_cache_processing_note.pdf). Highlights: 1) Onshore processing: for EU-region tenant data we route inference traffic to EU-dedicated pools; only metadata and aggregated telemetry may transit to US-based analytics systems for platform health. 2) Edge caching partner (CacheWave) processes only URL-level metadata and non-sensitive headers for caching, and by default we do NOT send full request bodies. Logs are retained for 14 days in the EU region before rolling up; we can enable an EU-only retention policy if that's required by CloudNova. 3) DPA addendum: attached is a sample addendum we use for temporary partners (redwood-dpa-addendum-sample.docx) — it includes audit rights and export control clauses.

If CloudNova needs a stricter retention or onshore-fallback, we can propose a canary configuration or an enclave for the tenant.

Kimberly Park
Director, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Maya — apologies for the short delay. Quick answers and next steps below (summarized):

- CacheWave storage location: the EU tenant buckets for CacheWave are hosted in the Amsterdam region. Logs for EU-configured tenants are retained in EU-only buckets; we have validated this with the partner and can provide a short attestation letter.
- KMS / encryption: CacheWave supports customer-managed KMS for log encryption. For our standard integration we encrypt logs with a Redwood-managed key; if CloudNova requires customer-specific KMS we can enable a tenant-scoped KMS tie-in (this requires a one-week enablement window).
- Reconstruction risk: CacheWave's contractually-scoped processing is limited to URL metadata, cache keys and non-sensitive headers; they do not receive bodies for inference requests. Kimberly attached a short technical note that explains why reconstruction is not feasible with the fields we send.
- Certifications: CacheWave provided an ISO/IEC 27001 cert and an SOC2 Type II attestation for their storage service; I've included the certification references in the drive folder.

Attachments (sent): subprocessor_roster_20260901.xlsx, edge_cache_processing_note.pdf, redwood-dpa-addendum-sample.docx.
Drive evidence pack: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3Csubprocessor-packages
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/CloudNova (Deal ID: 9876)

If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-minute clarifying call tomorrow with Jonas and the CacheWave technical lead to walk through the logs/retention model and KMS options.

Best,
